description: Canonical registry of MLS (RFC 9420) extensions required by Arkret profiles, including the standard required_capabilities extension and Arkret private-use extensions. Maintained so SDKs and conformance tooling have a single machine-readable entry for every required codepoint and context.

private_use_range.reference: RFC 9420 §17.6; IANA MLS Extension Types registry (private-use range)

extensions.name: required_capabilities
extensions.carries: RFC 9420 extension, proposal, and credential codepoints that every group member must support; Arkret lists 0xF1C0, 0xF1C1, and 0xF1C2

extensions.name: mls_governance_binding
extensions.carries: Arkret Realm/Circle governance binding inside the MLS GroupContext

extensions.name: keypackage_capabilities
extensions.carries: Canonical supported KeyPackage capability identifiers in the signed LeafNode
extensions.wire_encoding: deterministic CBOR definite-length array of UTF-8 text strings, byte-lexicographically sorted and unique

extensions.name: required_keypackage_capabilities
extensions.carries: Canonical active KeyPackage capability identifiers required of every member and authorized for use in the current group epoch
extensions.wire_encoding: deterministic CBOR definite-length array of UTF-8 text strings, byte-lexicographically sorted and unique
